describes: packages/plugin/link: the engine-backed and annotation-backed link sources, refetch on annotation events, the link-nav behavior and engaged(), and activate through the stage, the action engine, or back to the embedder.

cases.name: viewer-only-page-cache
cases.covers: Without the annotation plugin linksOn reads the engine-backed cache (empty until loaded). ensurePage lists the page once, keeps visible links with a target (hidden and noView dropped, invisible kept), ids obj: refs by object number and every other ref by page and index, converts the rect through the page crop, copies a truthy activate tree, flags hover events from either cursor root, and marks group children attached. A loaded page, or one the document does not have, asks nothing.

cases.name: viewer-only-malformed-lists
cases.covers: A list the fulfilled handler throws on (no annotations member, a null entry, a link without flags, ref or rect) caches nothing; a non-link without flags is skipped before flags are read. A missing index prints as undefined in the id and a rect without edges converts to NaN.

cases.name: viewer-only-loads-in-flight
cases.covers: A second ensureLoaded while a list is in flight joins it (v2 listed the page again). A refused list leaves the page unloaded, so the next ensureLoaded retries.

cases.name: viewer-only-refetch-on-events
cases.covers: Created, updated, moved (by its first entry) and deleted annotation events refetch a cached page; an empty move, an uncached page and any other event ask nothing. Closing the document releases the subscription.

cases.name: annotation-backed-source
cases.covers: With the annotation plugin linksOn is its folded model (hidden links excluded, no engine read), ensurePage defers to it, and annotation events never make this plugin fetch: the cache stays empty.

cases.name: link-nav-behavior
cases.covers: With the annotation plugin init registers the link-nav behavior: it matches link annotations only and is engaged while the active tool enables link-nav, as engaged() is. The link tool (no link-nav) hands links to the annotation plane; pan takes them back.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: engaged-follows-the-active-tool
cases.covers: Without the annotation plugin engaged() still reads the hub: true under pointer, false under a tool without link-nav.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: activate-without-a-stage
cases.covers: With no stage a goto hands back its explicit destination; uri and named report their member; javascript, goto-remote, launch and unsupported are reported whole. An activate tree without the actions plugin takes the same classic path. onActivate sees every activation.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: activate-without-a-listener
cases.covers: Without an onActivate config activation still runs and returns its outcome.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: activate-reveals-through-the-stage
cases.covers: With a stage a goto to a page of the document reveals its destination smoothly (xyz, fit, fitH, fitR on an offset crop) and reports revealed; a goto to a page the document lacks hands back the destination.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: activate-reveals-smoothly
cases.covers: The reveal is smooth whatever the stage scrollBehavior setting: with frames the camera tweens to the destination.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: activate-destination-that-cannot-invert
cases.covers: A goto to a page whose userUnit is 0 throws the geometry error out of activate before onActivate runs.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: a-throwing-listener-throws-out-of-activate
cases.covers: onActivate runs after the built-in handling, so its throw leaves the reveal done and escapes activate.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: activate-dispatches-through-actions
cases.covers: With the actions plugin and an activate tree the action engine takes the activation as a user dispatch from a link source (ref and pon when given) and the outcome carries its promise, resolved with the dispatch result; the goto executor reveals. A context without a truthy tree, or none at all, takes the classic path even with actions present.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: hit-testing-and-lookup
cases.covers: getLinkAt answers the smallest link whose bounds hold the point (edges included, the first of equal areas), null off every link; getLink finds a link by id or answers null. activateAt activates the link under the point with the page in its context, a Link input carrying its own ref and activate tree, and answers null off every link.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: hit-testing-by-area
cases.covers: getLinkAt compares areas, not perimeters or aspect ratios: under a point inside a tall, a square and a wide link it answers the tall one (the first of the two smallest areas), and off the tall one the wide one, whose area is smaller than the square's though its sides sum higher. A point right of every link, or below every link, answers null.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: activate-at-dispatches-with-the-page
cases.covers: With the actions plugin activateAt dispatches the tree the link under the point carries, from a link source that names the hit page and the link ref. An empty context keeps both the page and the link's own tree.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: labels-and-resolution
cases.covers: getLabel reads a Link’s target or a bare target: the uri, a fixed goto label, the name, and Link for anything else. resolve has no side effect: a goto to a page of the document resolves to a reveal with its page index and options, one to a page the document lacks to its destination, uri and named to their member, and the rest to reported.

cases.name: list-all-links-and-loaded-events
cases.covers: Without the annotation plugin isLoaded follows the cache; listAllLinks loads every page and answers their links in page order; onLoaded fires for each page that loaded (not for a refused read) and again when an annotation event refetches a cached page.

cases.name: list-all-links-annotation-backed
cases.covers: With the annotation plugin every page is loaded and listAllLinks reads its folded model without an engine read.
cases.reason: Pins activation outcomes, reveals and hit tests, through call outcomes, onActivate callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.
